admission.justification: Realized across columnState.ts, DocumentChat.tsx, ExplainerColumn.tsx, PaseoChatFrame.tsx, and paseoFrameControl.ts and guarded by component and composed cockpit tests; prevents deterministic mid-build explainer chat freezes from exhausting retries while hidden and prevents unrecoverable agent-problem notices.

applicability: Explainer column frame targeting in Review and Operations, reveal re-sync on PaseoChatFrame activation, and explicit Retry on paseo-frame-agent-problem.
conditions: computeFrameTarget, DocumentChat.resolveDocumentFrameProps, ExplainerColumn, and ExplainerFrame all pass null whenever showFrame is false (no non-explainer row selected; phase is placeholder, first-request, building, or retired).
When active transitions from false to true with a non-null unshown target not already steered in that render, useFrameController calls controller.resyncIfUnshown to resend ar.open without reload.

FrameNotices renders Retry inside paseo-frame-agent-problem: ready frames call retryOpen without reload while unavailable frames reload, preserving TrayColumnDock geometry, archived-target form handling, and origin checks.
exclusions: An explicitly selected non-explainer row from the header menu makes showFrame true (Boolean(selectedRow)) and yields a non-null frameTarget even during placeholder, first-request, building, or retired phases.
Backend explainer_service.py mid-build generation and agentId publication remain unchanged as honest build state.
Hiding an active frame (active true to false) never triggers resyncIfUnshown or a reload.

evidence: npx --prefix dashboard vitest run src/explainer/ExplainerColumn.test.tsx src/cockpit/reviewExplainerColumn.test.tsx src/cockpit/PaseoChatFrame.retry.test.tsx; report 261112-BUG-L62-worker-9e7b04bc-afc8-55ae-afa7-c9e1e9ca0088.md

statement: Explainer frame targeting is gated on showFrame (Boolean(selectedRow) || phase === 'live' || phase === 'closed') so hidden phases with no non-explainer row selected never steer PaseoFrameControl, revealing an unshown target re-syncs via ar.open without reload when ready, and paseo-frame-agent-problem provides an explicit Retry button that re-sends ar.open when ready or reloads when unavailable while preserving INV-M71W78, INV-S3NMAZ, and INV-1PVR72.
title: showFrame gates explainer targeting; reveal and Retry recover cleanly
